title: Above the catalog average
brief: Find prices above the overall average without changing the comparison grain.
instructions: Return products strictly above the exact catalog average. Compare against all products without rounding the average or weighting by transactions.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes product_id,unit_price from products without solving above the catalog average.

hints.text: A scalar aggregate compares each product with one overall statistic.
Compare price times product count against the sum of prices to avoid rounding the mean.
Catalog price is independent of transaction price; equality is excluded.
